```{r global, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
source("global.R")

teams_df   <- get_teams()
rosters_df <- get_rosters()
sched_df   <- get_schedules()
stats_raw  <- get_player_stats()

# Columns a "Custom View" can plot / group by. Restricting to a known-good
# subset keeps the Custom View Builder from breaking on odd nflverse columns.
NUMERIC_METRICS <- c(
  "fantasy_points", "passing_yards", "passing_tds", "interceptions",
  "rushing_yards", "rushing_tds", "carries",
  "receiving_yards", "receiving_tds", "receptions", "targets"
)
GROUP_FIELDS <- c("team" = "team", "position" = "position", "player" = "player_display_name")
```

```{r sidebar-server, context="server"}
# Week range depends on the selected season's schedule, so build it reactively.
output$week_range_ui <- renderUI({
  req(input$season)
  season_sched <- sched_df %>% filter(season == as.integer(input$season))
  max_week <- if (nrow(season_sched) > 0) max(season_sched$week, na.rm = TRUE) else 18
  sliderInput("week_range", "Week range", min = 1, max = max_week,
              value = c(1, max_week), step = 1)
})

# Reactive: season's player stats, scored, filtered to the chosen week range.
scored_stats <- reactive({
  req(input$season, input$week_range, input$scoring_preset)
  scoring <- SCORING_PRESETS[[input$scoring_preset]]

  season_num <- as.integer(input$season)
  df <- if (season_num == CURRENT_SEASON) stats_raw else get_player_stats(season_num)

  df %>%
    filter(season == season_num,
           week >= input$week_range[1], week <= input$week_range[2]) %>%
    compute_fantasy_points(scoring)
})
```

```{r overview-server, context="server"}
season_totals <- reactive({
  scored_stats() %>%
    group_by(player_id, player_display_name, position, team) %>%
    summarise(
      fantasy_points = sum(fantasy_points, na.rm = TRUE),
      games = n_distinct(week),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(fantasy_points))
})

output$vb_top_scorer <- renderValueBox({
  d <- season_totals()
  req(nrow(d) > 0)
  top <- d[1, ]
  valueBox(top$player_display_name,
           caption = sprintf("%.1f pts (%s)", top$fantasy_points, top$position),
           icon = "fa-trophy", color = APP_ACCENT)
})

output$vb_riser <- renderValueBox({
  d <- scored_stats() %>%
    group_by(player_id, player_display_name) %>%
    filter(n_distinct(week) >= 2) %>%
    arrange(week, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    summarise(delta = last(fantasy_points) - first(fantasy_points), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(delta))
  req(nrow(d) > 0)
  top <- d[1, ]
  valueBox(top$player_display_name,
           caption = sprintf("+%.1f pts vs. first week shown", top$delta),
           icon = "fa-arrow-trend-up", color = "success")
})

output$vb_weeks <- renderValueBox({
  valueBox(paste0(input$week_range[1], "\u2013", input$week_range[2]),
           caption = "Weeks in current view", icon = "fa-calendar-week", color = "info")
})

output$vb_players <- renderValueBox({
  valueBox(n_distinct(scored_stats()$player_id),
           caption = "Players with a stat line", icon = "fa-users", color = "secondary")
})

output$overview_table <- render_gt({
  d <- season_totals() %>%
    head(15) %>%
    left_join(teams_df %>% select(team_abbr, team_logo_espn), by = c("team" = "team_abbr"))

  d %>%
    select(team_logo_espn, player_display_name, position, team, games, fantasy_points) %>%
    gt() %>%
    text_transform(
      locations = cells_body(columns = team_logo_espn),
      fn = function(x) web_image(url = x, height = 22)
    ) %>%
    cols_label(
      team_logo_espn = "", player_display_name = "Player", position = "Pos",
      team = "Team", games = "GP", fantasy_points = "Fantasy Pts"
    ) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = fantasy_points, decimals = 1) %>%
    data_color(columns = fantasy_points,
               colors = scales::col_numeric(c(APP_PANEL_BG, APP_ACCENT), domain = NULL)) %>%
    tab_options(table.background.color = APP_PANEL_BG,
                table.font.color = APP_TEXT,
                column_labels.background.color = APP_PANEL_BG,
                table.border.top.style = "none")
})
```

```{r explorer-server, context="server"}
output$pe_team_ui <- renderUI({
  selectInput("pe_team", "Team", choices = c("All", sort(unique(teams_df$team_abbr))),
              selected = "All")
})

pe_filtered <- reactive({
  d <- scored_stats()
  if (!is.null(input$pe_position) && input$pe_position != "All") {
    d <- d %>% filter(position == input$pe_position)
  }
  if (!is.null(input$pe_team) && input$pe_team != "All") {
    d <- d %>% filter(team == input$pe_team)
  }
  d
})

pe_table_data <- reactive({
  pe_filtered() %>%
    group_by(player_id, player_display_name, position, team) %>%
    summarise(games = n_distinct(week),
              fantasy_points = sum(fantasy_points, na.rm = TRUE),
              ppg = round(fantasy_points / pmax(games, 1), 1),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(fantasy_points))
})

output$player_table <- renderDT({
  datatable(
    pe_table_data() %>% select(-player_id),
    selection = "single", rownames = FALSE,
    colnames = c("Player", "Pos", "Team", "GP", "Fantasy Pts", "PPG"),
    options = list(pageLength = 10, dom = "ftip")
  ) %>% formatStyle(columns = seq_len(ncol(pe_table_data()) - 1),
                     backgroundColor = APP_PANEL_BG, color = APP_TEXT)
})

selected_player_id <- reactive({
  idx <- input$player_table_rows_selected
  req(length(idx) == 1)
  pe_table_data()$player_id[idx]
})

output$player_gamelog <- renderPlotly({
  idx <- input$player_table_rows_selected
  if (is.null(idx) || length(idx) != 1) {
    return(plotly_empty(type = "scatter", mode = "markers") %>%
             layout(paper_bgcolor = APP_PANEL_BG, plot_bgcolor = APP_PANEL_BG,
                    annotations = list(text = "Click a player row to see their weekly game log",
                                        showarrow = FALSE, font = list(color = APP_MUTED))))
  }

  pid <- selected_player_id()
  gl <- pe_filtered() %>% filter(player_id == pid) %>% arrange(week)
  req(nrow(gl) > 0)

  # Pull opponent for each week from the schedule so we can label points
  # with the opposing team's logo.
  gl <- gl %>%
    left_join(
      sched_df %>%
        select(season, week, home_team, away_team) %>%
        pivot_longer(c(home_team, away_team), names_to = "side", values_to = "team") %>%
        mutate(opponent = if_else(side == "home_team", NA_character_, NA_character_)),
      by = c("season", "week", "team")
    )
  # Simpler/robust opponent lookup: for each row's team+week, find the other
  # side of that game in the schedule.
  opp_lookup <- sched_df %>%
    filter(season == unique(gl$season)[1]) %>%
    select(week, home_team, away_team) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(home_team, away_team), names_to = "side", values_to = "team") %>%
    mutate(opponent = if_else(side == "home_team",
                               sched_df$away_team[match(week, sched_df$week)],
                               sched_df$home_team[match(week, sched_df$week)]))
  gl <- gl %>% left_join(opp_lookup %>% select(week, team, opponent), by = c("week", "team"))
  gl <- gl %>% left_join(teams_df %>% select(team_abbr, team_logo_espn),
                          by = c("opponent" = "team_abbr"))

  p <- plot_ly(gl, x = ~week, y = ~fantasy_points, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
               line = list(color = APP_ACCENT), marker = list(color = APP_ACCENT, size = 6),
               text = ~paste0("Week ", week, " vs ", opponent, ": ", fantasy_points, " pts"),
               hoverinfo = "text")

  # Overlay opponent logos as image annotations at each point (nflplotR is
  # ggplot-oriented; for an interactive plotly chart we place the logos
  # directly via plotly's `images` layout so they stay crisp on hover/zoom).
  logo_images <- gl %>%
    filter(!is.na(team_logo_espn)) %>%
    transmute(source = team_logo_espn, x = week, y = fantasy_points,
              xref = "x", yref = "y", sizex = 1.2, sizey = max(gl$fantasy_points, 1) * 0.12,
              xanchor = "center", yanchor = "bottom") %>%
    purrr::transpose()

  p %>%
    layout(
      paper_bgcolor = APP_PANEL_BG, plot_bgcolor = APP_PANEL_BG,
      font = list(color = APP_TEXT),
      xaxis = list(title = "Week", gridcolor = "#242c40"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Fantasy Points", gridcolor = "#242c40"),
      images = logo_images
    )
})
```

```{r team-compare-server, context="server"}
output$tc_team_picker <- renderUI({
  selectInput("tc_teams", NULL, choices = sort(unique(teams_df$team_abbr)),
              selected = sort(unique(teams_df$team_abbr))[1:4], multiple = TRUE)
})

tc_data <- reactive({
  req(input$tc_teams)
  scored_stats() %>%
    filter(team %in% input$tc_teams) %>%
    group_by(team) %>%
    summarise(points_for = sum(fantasy_points, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
})

output$tc_points_for <- renderPlot({
  d <- tc_data()
  req(nrow(d) > 0)
  ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(team, points_for), y = points_for, fill = team)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.65) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(
      sapply(d$team, function(a) team_primary_color(teams_df, a)), d$team)) +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Total Fantasy Points Scored (Standard)") +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.y = nflplotR::element_nfl_logo(size = 1.1)) +
    gg_dark_theme()
})

# "Points allowed": sum of fantasy points scored *against* each team, i.e.
# the fantasy output of every opposing offensive player each week.
tc_allowed_data <- reactive({
  req(input$tc_teams)
  s <- scored_stats()
  sched_w <- sched_df %>%
    select(season, week, home_team, away_team) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(home_team, away_team), names_to = "side", values_to = "team") %>%
    mutate(opponent = if_else(side == "home_team",
                               sched_df$away_team[match(interaction(week), interaction(sched_df$week))],
                               sched_df$home_team[match(interaction(week), interaction(sched_df$week))]))
  # Robust per-row opponent join (avoids the interaction()-based lookup above
  # being fragile across duplicate weeks/seasons).
  opp_map <- bind_rows(
    sched_df %>% transmute(season, week, team = home_team, opponent = away_team),
    sched_df %>% transmute(season, week, team = away_team, opponent = home_team)
  )
  s %>%
    left_join(opp_map, by = c("season", "week", "team")) %>%
    filter(opponent %in% input$tc_teams) %>%
    group_by(opponent) %>%
    summarise(points_allowed = sum(fantasy_points, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    rename(team = opponent)
})

output$tc_points_allowed <- renderPlot({
  d <- tc_allowed_data()
  req(nrow(d) > 0)
  ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(team, points_allowed), y = points_allowed, fill = team)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.65) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(
      sapply(d$team, function(a) team_primary_color(teams_df, a)), d$team)) +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Fantasy Points Allowed to Opponents") +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.y = nflplotR::element_nfl_logo(size = 1.1)) +
    gg_dark_theme()
})
```

### Custom Chart

```{r}
plotlyOutput("cv_chart_out")
```

```{r custom-view-server, context="server"}
saved_views <- reactiveValues(views = list())

cv_current_config <- reactive({
  list(metric = input$cv_metric, group = input$cv_group,
       chart = input$cv_chart, position = input$cv_position,
       week_range = input$week_range, season = input$season)
})

observeEvent(input$cv_save, {
  cfg <- cv_current_config()
  label <- sprintf("%s by %s (%s) — %s, wks %s\u2013%s",
                    cfg$metric, cfg$group, cfg$chart, cfg$season,
                    cfg$week_range[1], cfg$week_range[2])
  saved_views$views[[label]] <- cfg
})

output$cv_saved_picker <- renderUI({
  req(length(saved_views$views) > 0)
  selectInput("cv_load", "Saved views (this session)",
              choices = names(saved_views$views))
})

observeEvent(input$cv_load, {
  cfg <- saved_views$views[[input$cv_load]]
  req(cfg)
  updateSelectInput(session = getDefaultReactiveDomain(), "cv_metric", selected = cfg$metric)
  updateSelectInput(session = getDefaultReactiveDomain(), "cv_group", selected = cfg$group)
  updateSelectInput(session = getDefaultReactiveDomain(), "cv_chart", selected = cfg$chart)
  updateSelectInput(session = getDefaultReactiveDomain(), "cv_position", selected = cfg$position)
}, ignoreInit = TRUE)

cv_data <- reactive({
  req(input$cv_metric, input$cv_group)
  d <- scored_stats()
  if (!is.null(input$cv_position) && input$cv_position != "All") {
    d <- d %>% filter(position == input$cv_position)
  }
  group_col <- GROUP_FIELDS[[input$cv_group]]
  d %>%
    group_by(.group = .data[[group_col]]) %>%
    summarise(value = sum(.data[[input$cv_metric]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(value)) %>%
    head(25)
})

output$cv_chart_out <- renderPlotly({
  d <- cv_data()
  req(nrow(d) > 0)

  base <- plot_ly(d, x = ~.group, y = ~value,
                   text = ~paste0(.group, ": ", round(value, 1)), hoverinfo = "text",
                   marker = list(color = APP_ACCENT), line = list(color = APP_ACCENT))

  p <- switch(input$cv_chart,
    "Bar"     = base %>% add_bars(),
    "Line"    = base %>% add_lines(),
    "Scatter" = base %>% add_markers(marker = list(color = APP_ACCENT, size = 10))
  )

  p %>% layout(
    paper_bgcolor = APP_PANEL_BG, plot_bgcolor = APP_PANEL_BG,
    font = list(color = APP_TEXT),
    xaxis = list(title = names(GROUP_FIELDS)[GROUP_FIELDS == GROUP_FIELDS[[input$cv_group]]],
                 gridcolor = "#242c40", categoryorder = "total descending"),
    yaxis = list(title = input$cv_metric, gridcolor = "#242c40")
  )
})
```
